title: LSO Paralegal Ethics & Professional Responsibilities Practice Test 1 - Ethics & Professional Responsibilities - Trust Account Shortages
exam: LSO Paralegal Ethics & Professional Responsibilities Practice Test 1
subject: Ethics & Professional Responsibilities

questions.q: A paralegal realizes that due to a bank processing error, their mixed trust account is short by $200. What is the paralegal's **first action** to correct this?
options: Wait for the bank to reverse the error during the next billing cycle.
Immediately transfer $200 from their general account into the trust account to eliminate the shortage.
Call the client and ask for a further $200 deposit.
Close the trust account and open a new one.
questions.explain: LSO By-law 9 requires that a licensee who discovers a trust shortage must immediately pay sufficient funds into the account from their own general funds to eliminate the shortage. Trust accounts cannot remain in a deficit state.
